description: Command: the core's automation starts an automatic art job (Hub #679, #684). The envelope subject is `art`. The gateway refuses it from any client, the tracker admits it only when `requestedBy` is `bunny/core`, and its responder refuses any source but `bunny/core`, because the in-process bus checks none. The art module applies the automatic limits to every job this family admits, even one whose `origin` or `purpose` says otherwise. It has `art-request`'s start without typed text, and no cancel: the owner cancels any job with `art-request`. The validator refuses `variationOf` without the purpose `variation` or the reverse (art.ts).
